competitor_evidence.text: Lam Research addresses processes for back-end wafer-level packaging (WLP), which is an alternative to traditional wire bonding.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: We also address processes for back-end wafer-level packaging (“WLP”), which is an alternative to traditional wire bonding and can offer a smaller form factor, increased interconnect speed and bandwidth, and lower power consumption, among other benefits.

competitor_evidence.text: Lam Research offers advanced packaging solutions that support fan-out panel-level packaging.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: We offer advanced packaging solutions that support fan-out panel-level packaging, a process in which chips or chiplets are cut from a large format substrate sheet several times the size of a traditional silicon wafer, which increases yield and reduces waste and solutions that meet the need for 3D st

competitor_evidence.text: Lam Research provides products and services to maximize installed equipment performance, predictability, and operational efficiency.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Our Customer Support Business Group (“CSBG”) provides products and services to maximize installed equipment performance, predictability, and operational efficiency.

competitor_evidence.text: Lam Research offers a broad range of services to deliver value throughout the lifecycle of their equipment, including customer service, spares, upgrades, and new and refurbished non-leading edge products.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: We offer a broad range of services to deliver value throughout the lifecycle of our equipment, including customer service, spares, upgrades, and new and refurbished non-leading edge products in our deposition, etch, and clean markets.

competitor_evidence.text: Lam Research's service offerings include fleet level Equipment Intelligence® solutions to maximize the productivity of their customers.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Service offerings include fleet level Equipment Intelligence® solutions to maximize the productivity of our customers through system uptime or availability optimization, throughput improvements, and defect reduction.

competitor_evidence.text: Lam Research's spares product line focuses on product life extension to help customers increase the return on their capital purchases.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Our spares product line offers running cost optimization programs and focuses on product life extension to help customers increase the return on their capital purchases.

competitor_evidence.text: Lam Research offers new and refurbished non-leading edge products in deposition, etch, and clean markets.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Additionally, within CSBG, our Reliant® product line offers new and refurbished non-leading edge products in deposition, etch and clean markets for those applications that do not require the most advanced wafer processing capability.

competitor_evidence.text: Lam Research provides a range of deposition technologies including Electrochemical Deposition (ECD), Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD), and Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD).
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Deposition Metal Films Electrochemical Deposition (“ECD”) (Copper & Other) SABRE® family Chemical Vapor Deposition (“CVD”) Atomic Layer Deposition (“ALD”) (Tungsten & Molybdenum) ALTUS® family

competitor_evidence.text: Lam Research provides cleaning technologies including Wet Clean and Dry Plasma Clean.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Clean Wafer Cleaning Wet Clean EOS®, DV-Prime®, Da Vinci®, SP Series families Bevel Cleaning Dry Plasma Clean Coronus® family

competitor_evidence.text: VECTOR® PECVD products are designed to provide the performance and flexibility needed to create these enabling structures within a wide range of challenging device applications.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Our VECTOR® PECVD products are designed to provide the performance and flexibility needed to create these enabling structures within a wide range of challenging device applications.

competitor_evidence.text: VECTOR® produces superior thin film quality, along with exceptional within-wafer and wafer-to-wafer uniformity.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: As a result of its design, VECTOR® produces superior thin film quality, along with exceptional within-wafer and wafer-to-wafer uniformity.

competitor_evidence.text: Reactive ion etch processing enables device-critical formation steps to enable transistor performance, create storage capacitors, and memory cells.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Reactive ion etch processing enables device-critical formation steps to enable transistor performance, create storage capacitors, and memory cells.

competitor_evidence.text: Low temperature, cryogenic etching enables the use of new, novel chemistries to deliver increased high aspect ratio etch capability.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Low temperature, cryogenic etching enables the use of new, novel chemistries to deliver increased high aspect ratio etch capability.

competitor_evidence.text: Akara® product family delivers a high degree of process control for next-generation logic and memory devices, including gate-all-around architectures and advanced DRAM and NAND nodes.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Our Akara® product family delivers a high degree of process control for next-generation logic and memory devices, including gate-all-around architectures and advanced DRAM and NAND nodes.

competitor_evidence.text: Akara® incorporates proprietary plasma technologies, to enhance etch precision, selectivity, and defect control.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Akara® incorporates proprietary plasma technologies, to enhance etch precision, selectivity, and defect control.

competitor_evidence.text: Integrated with Lam’s Sense.i® platform and Equipment Intelligence® solutions, Akara® is designed to support high-volume manufacturing, improve yield, and reduce overall cost of ownership.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Integrated with Lam’s Sense.i® platform and Equipment Intelligence® solutions, Akara® is designed to support high-volume manufacturing, improve yield, and reduce overall cost of ownership.

competitor_evidence.text: Selective etch processes enable the removal of targeted materials from wafer surfaces while preserving adjacent materials and are used in the fabrication of advanced logic and memory devices that require precise control at nanoscale dimensions.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Selective etch processes enable the removal of targeted materials from wafer surfaces while preserving adjacent materials and are used in the fabrication of advanced logic and memory devices that require precise control at nanoscale dimensions.

competitor_evidence.text: Semiconductor device architectures continue to evolve to address increasing requirements for device density, performance, and energy efficiency.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Semiconductor device architectures continue to evolve to address increasing requirements for device density, performance, and energy efficiency.

competitor_evidence.text: These transitions require manufacturing processes capable of selectively and uniformly removing materials in three dimensions, increasing the importance of process control and selectivity to avoid damage to neighboring or underlying layers as device structures become more complex.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: These transitions require manufacturing processes capable of selectively and uniformly removing materials in three dimensions, increasing the importance of process control and selectivity to avoid damage to neighboring or underlying layers as device structures become more complex.

competitor_evidence.text: Inspection and review tools are used to identify, locate, characterize, review, and analyze defects on various surfaces of patterned and unpatterned wafers.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Inspection and review tools are used to identify, locate, characterize, review, and analyze defects on various surfaces of patterned and unpatterned wafers.

competitor_evidence.text: Metrology systems are used to measure pattern dimensions, film thickness(es), film stress, layer-to-layer alignment, pattern placement, surface topography and electro-optical properties for wafers.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Metrology systems are used to measure pattern dimensions, film thickness(es), film stress, layer-to-layer alignment, pattern placement, surface topography and electro-optical properties for wafers.

competitor_evidence.text: Chemical process control equipment qualifies incoming supplies, manages tool inputs, adjusts chamber/bath conditions and monitors process waste.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Chemical process control equipment qualifies incoming supplies, manages tool inputs, adjusts chamber/bath conditions and monitors process waste.

competitor_evidence.text: Wired and wireless sensor wafers and reticles provide comprehensive data used to visualize, diagnose and control process conditions in the equipment used to manufacture chips and reticles.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Wired and wireless sensor wafers and reticles provide comprehensive data used to visualize, diagnose and control process conditions in the equipment used to manufacture chips and reticles.

competitor_evidence.text: Wafer defect inspection, review and metrology systems are used to help wafer/substrate manufacturers manage quality throughout the wafer fabrication process by detecting defects, characterizing surface quality and assessing wafer geometry.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Wafer defect inspection, review and metrology systems are used to help wafer/substrate manufacturers manage quality throughout the wafer fabrication process by detecting defects, characterizing surface quality and assessing wafer geometry.

competitor_evidence.text: Reticle inspection and metrology systems help reticle blank, patterned optical reticle, patterned EUV reticle, and chip manufacturers identify defects, pattern placement errors, and process issues during reticle manufacturing.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Reticle inspection and metrology systems help reticle blank, patterned optical reticle, patterned EUV reticle, and chip manufacturers identify defects, pattern placement errors, and process issues during reticle manufacturing.

competitor_evidence.text: Wafer inspection and metrology systems for advanced wafer-level packaging help packaging manufacturers detect, resolve and monitor excursions to provide greater control of quality for improved device performance.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Wafer inspection and metrology systems for advanced wafer-level packaging help packaging manufacturers detect, resolve and monitor excursions to provide greater control of quality for improved device performance.

competitor_evidence.text: Chemistry process monitoring systems analyze and monitor wet chemicals used in wafer-level packaging (WLP), panel-level packaging (PLP), and IC substrates.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Chemistry process monitoring systems analyze and monitor wet chemicals used in wafer-level packaging (WLP), panel-level packaging (PLP), and IC substrates.

competitor_evidence.text: Software solutions centralize and analyze the data produced by inspection, metrology and process systems for chip, wafer, reticle and packaging manufacturing.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Software solutions centralize and analyze the data produced by inspection, metrology and process systems for chip, wafer, reticle and packaging manufacturing.

competitor_evidence.text: These solutions provide run-time process control, defect excursion identification, process corrections and defect classification to accelerate yield learning rates and reduce production risk.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: These solutions provide run-time process control, defect excursion identification, process corrections and defect classification to accelerate yield learning rates and reduce production risk.

competitor_evidence.text: Patterning simulation software allows researchers to evaluate advanced patterning technologies, such as EUV lithography and multiple patterning techniques.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Patterning simulation software allows researchers to evaluate advanced patterning technologies, such as EUV lithography and multiple patterning techniques.

competitor_evidence.text: The Specialty Semiconductor Process segment develops and sells advanced vacuum deposition and etching process tools, which are used by a broad range of specialty semiconductor customers.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: The Specialty Semiconductor Process segment develops and sells advanced vacuum deposition and etching process tools, which are used by a broad range of specialty semiconductor customers.

sources.title: APPLIED MATERIALS INC /DE XBRL company facts

evidence.text: Applied Materials, Inc. is the leader in the materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every semiconductor in the world.
evidence.excerpt: Applied Materials, Inc. is the leader in the materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every semiconductor in the world.

evidence.text: Our customers’ products are used across personal computing devices, mobile phones, artificial intelligence (AI) and data center servers, automobiles, connected devices, industrial applications and consumer electronics.
evidence.excerpt: Our customers’ products are used across personal computing devices, mobile phones, artificial intelligence (AI) and data center servers, automobiles, connected devices, industrial applications and consumer electronics.

evidence.text: The Semiconductor Systems segment represents the largest contributor to our net revenue.
evidence.excerpt: The Semiconductor Systems segment represents the largest contributor to our net revenue.

evidence.text: Our Semiconductor Systems segment designs, develops, manufactures and sells a wide range of equipment used to fabricate semiconductor chips, also referred to as integrated circuits (ICs).
evidence.excerpt: Our Semiconductor Systems segment designs, develops, manufactures and sells a wide range of equipment used to fabricate semiconductor chips, also referred to as integrated circuits (ICs).

evidence.text: Our products address steps across materials engineering, process control and advanced packaging, including the conversion of patterns into device structures, transistor and interconnect fabrication, metrology, inspection and review, and packaging technologies for connecting finished IC die.
evidence.excerpt: Our products address steps across materials engineering, process control and advanced packaging, including the conversion of patterns into device structures, transistor and interconnect fabrication, metrology, inspection and review, and packaging technologies for connecting finished IC die.

evidence.text: Our equipment helps customers improve the power, performance, yield and costs of semiconductor devices.
evidence.excerpt: Our equipment helps customers improve the power, performance, yield and costs of semiconductor devices.

evidence.text: Our patterning systems and technologies address challenges resulting from shrinking pattern dimensions and the growing complexity in vertical stacking found in today’s most advanced semiconductor devices.
evidence.excerpt: Our patterning systems and technologies address challenges resulting from shrinking pattern dimensions and the growing complexity in vertical stacking found in today’s most advanced semiconductor devices.

evidence.text: Our transistor and interconnect products and technologies enable continued power and performance improvements of 3D transistors.
evidence.excerpt: Our transistor and interconnect products and technologies enable continued power and performance improvements of 3D transistors.

evidence.text: Our process control systems employ optical and eBeam technologies that allow customers to inspect and review critical semiconductor architectures throughout the manufacturing process.
evidence.excerpt: Our process control systems employ optical and eBeam technologies that allow customers to inspect and review critical semiconductor architectures throughout the manufacturing process.

evidence.text: Applied Materials' advanced packaging systems use materials engineering expertise to connect multiple chips together through heterogeneous integration.
evidence.excerpt: Our advanced packaging systems use our materials engineering expertise to allow customers to connect multiple chips together through heterogeneous integration.

evidence.text: Applied Materials' Semiconductor Systems sales are to customers that serve the foundry, logic and other; dynamic random access memory (DRAM); and flash memory (NAND) markets.
evidence.excerpt: Our Semiconductor Systems sales are to customers that serve the following markets: foundry, logic and other; dynamic random access memory (DRAM); and flash memory (NAND).

evidence.text: Leading-edge technology nodes are defined as 7 nanometers and smaller.
evidence.excerpt: Leading-edge represents customers that are producing on the most advanced technology nodes, defined as 7 nanometers and smaller.

evidence.text: Non-leading edge technology nodes serve markets such as internet of things, communications, automotive, power and sensors.
evidence.excerpt: Non-leading edge technology nodes serve markets such as internet of things, communications, automotive, power and sensors.

evidence.text: Our AGS segment provides services, spares and factory automation software to customer fabrication plants globally.
evidence.excerpt: Our AGS segment provides services, spares and factory automation software to customer fabrication plants globally.

evidence.text: Through October 26, 2025, our AGS segment also manufactured and sold 200 millimeter (200mm) and other equipment to customers globally that serve non-leading-edge markets.
evidence.excerpt: Through October 26, 2025, our AGS segment also manufactured and sold 200 millimeter (200mm) and other equipment to customers globally that serve non-leading-edge markets.

evidence.text: Effective the first quarter of fiscal 2026, our 200mm equipment business will be moved to our Semiconductor Systems segment.
evidence.excerpt: Effective the first quarter of fiscal 2026, our 200mm equipment business will be moved to our Semiconductor Systems segment.

evidence.text: AGS’s transactional and subscription service products, spares and factory automation software is purchased by customers to optimize the performance of our large, global installed base of semiconductor and other equipment.
evidence.excerpt: AGS’s transactional and subscription service products, spares and factory automation software is purchased by customers to optimize the performance of our large, global installed base of semiconductor and other equipment.

evidence.text: These solutions are also used to optimize plant performance and productivity.
evidence.excerpt: These solutions are also used to optimize plant performance and productivity.

evidence.text: Customer demand is fulfilled through a global distribution system and trained field engineers located near customer sites to support our semiconductor and other equipment worldwide.
evidence.excerpt: Customer demand is fulfilled through a global distribution system and trained field engineers located near customer sites to support our semiconductor and other equipment worldwide.

evidence.text: Backlog consisted of: (1) orders for which written authorizations have been accepted, or shipment has occurred but revenue has not been recognized; and (2) contractual service revenue and maintenance fees.
evidence.excerpt: Backlog consisted of: (1) orders for which written authorizations have been accepted, or shipment has occurred but revenue has not been recognized; and (2) contractual service revenue and maintenance fees.

evidence.text: Our business is based on capital equipment investments by major semiconductor and other manufacturers, and is subject to significant variability in customer demand for our products.
evidence.excerpt: Our business is based on capital equipment investments by major semiconductor and other manufacturers, and is subject to significant variability in customer demand for our products.

evidence.text: Customers’ expenditures depend on many factors, including: general economic conditions; anticipated market demand and pricing for semiconductors and other electronic devices; the development of new technologies; customers’ factory utilization; capital resources and financing; trade policies and export regulations; and government incentives.

evidence.excerpt: The industries in which we operate are highly competitive and characterized by rapid technological change.
